title: 2014 Japan — Sutil/Bianchi case study
description: Sutil crashed at Turn 7 in worsening rain. A mobile crane recovered his car under local double yellows. Bianchi lost control at the same corner a lap later and struck the recovery vehicle.
presentation_note: This scenario is presented as a historical sensor-fusion case study. The FIA accident panel stated that procedures following Sutil's crash were consistent with the rules and practices in use at the time. FlagSense is not being used here to assign fault or claim that a different automated recommendation would necessarily have changed the outcome.
notes: All replay seconds except the Sutil T=0 anchor are illustrative placements, not historical event timing.
The FIA panel did not establish a late Safety Car after Sutil's crash.
limitations: No usable 2014 car telemetry was verified.
No exact public action timestamps were used.
No measured meteorological values or licensed photograph are bundled.
Prototype geometry is simulated and is not Suzuka GPS.
